profile_text.body:
Kyndryl is a public company, traded as KD, that was founded in 2021 and is headquartered in New York, NY, USA. Martin Schroeter is Chairman and CEO. The company's site says it designs, builds, manages and modernizes the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. It is registered with the SEC as Kyndryl Holdings, Inc. under CIK 0001867072.

The site's material centers on AI as a theme rather than a named product line. Kyndryl points to its 2026 People Readiness Report, which it says reveals a decline in workforce readiness as AI adoption surges. It describes AI-native enterprises as those that put AI at the core of their business to create conditions for continuous growth, efficiency and resilience. It also features a Kyndryl Conversations episode with Martin Schroeter and Kyndryl Global Head of Strategy Kris Lovejoy on why modernization is becoming harder in the AI era, and a podcast from The Innovation Show and The Kyndryl Institute on how AI is evolving business models. A further item addresses resilience as geopolitical tensions escalate and AI accelerates attackers' capabilities.

The record shows no tracked products, no MCP servers, and no lawsuits. It lists New York as a jurisdiction with 459 cases.
